label: departed from
definition: Person or organization X leaves or withdraws physically from geographic place Y.
scope_notes: This diffuse cluster mixes departure, arrival, legal occupation, publication and residence paths. Leave, withdraw-from, withdrawal and pull-out collectively define the selected coherent departure component. Arrival is a competing direction and residence is a different predicate; neither is unioned into it. No uniquely dominant interpretation is guaranteed, so relation-level predicate choice is a material caveat.
